page.title: Notation
page.lead: Read and write move notation as on a scoresheet: play the announced move, follow a sequence of written moves, write a puzzle's solution without playing it. Positions taken from puzzles, unrated.
page.letters: Pieces: {letters} (king, queen, rook, bishop, knight). Castling: O-O, O-O-O.
page.mindMap: These exercises are also in chapter 1 of the Visualization path.
page.noRepertoire: You need a repertoire with at least {n} segments to complete its lines.

play.title: Play the announced move
play.desc: A move is written, play it on the board.

sequence.title: Sequence of written moves
sequence.desc: Play a sequence of written moves, for both sides.

write.title: Write the solution
write.desc: Solve the puzzle in your head and write the whole line, without playing it.

line.title: Complete a line
line.desc: A line from your repertoire plays out: write its last moves.

game_play.title: Replay a famous game
game_play.desc: Read 6 half-moves of a legendary game and replay them, chunk after chunk.

game_write.title: Write down a famous game
game_write.desc: Watch 6 half-moves of a legendary game, then write them down.

player.sequenceText: Play each move, for White as well as for Black.
player.writeText: {side} to move: find the solution and write it, {n} half-move | {side} to move: find the solution and write it, {n} half-moves
player.wrongText: Look at the right answer before moving on.
player.lineText: {line}: write what follows, {n} half-move | {line}: write what follows, {n} half-moves
player.gameWriteText: {label}: write the {n} half-moves you just saw.

reasons.illegal: Half-move {n} is not a legal move.
reasons.wrong: Half-move {n} is not the right one.
reasons.long: Too many moves: the line ends before half-move {n}.
